project_overview.name: VITRONX
project_overview.tagline: AI-Powered Operating System for Digital Marketing Agencies
project_overview.description: Multi-tenant digital marketing agency OS where agencies manage high-volume clients, campaigns, social calendars, Kanban task boards, AI recommendation engines, ad spend analytics, approval queues, and lead pipelines.

archetype_and_theme.archetype: ARCHETYPE 2 & 4 HYBRID: Tactical Performance Pro meets Swiss Precision
archetype_and_theme.theme_mode: Dark Theme Primary (Linear + ClickUp + HubSpot inspired)
archetype_and_theme.design_philosophy: Deep slate/obsidian canvas (#0A0C10) with crisp subtle borders (#1E222D), layered elevation gray shifts (#11141B, #161A23), and Electric Amber-Cyan dual accents (#FF9F1C electric amber for tactical urgency, #00E5FF cyan electric pulse for AI intelligence). Rejects generic purple/violet gradients in favor of high-density clarity and long-session ergonomic comfort.
anti_patterns_banned: No generic purple/violet gradients (#7351B7 or indigo slop)
No pure #000000 black canvas (causes eye fatigue on long agency workflows)
No unstyled default HTML select/date inputs
No transparent dropdown menus or headers without blur and solid backdrop
No center-everything layouts for data tables and dashboard grids
No missing data-testid attributes on interactive elements

sidebar_and_layout.client_switcher: Header dropdown in sidebar featuring client logo, tier badge, workspace status (e.g. Acme Corp - Enterprise, Apex Health - Growth), search filter, and quick '+ Add Client' modal trigger.

hero_screen_concepts.title: Global Agency Command Hub
hero_screen_concepts.description: Cross-client health telemetry, MRR breakdown, active team workload, pending approval alerts, and high-impact AI agency insights.
key_elements: Agency MRR & Ad Spend KPI Bar
Client Health Matrix Grid (Status badges, ROAS, Campaign Pace)
Approval Queue Urgent Triage Widget
Agency Wide AI Revenue Opportunity Drawer

hero_screen_concepts.title: Client Specific Workspace (360 Command)
hero_screen_concepts.description: Unified client workspace with 20+ tabs switcher, live campaign performance chart, active deliverables, and client brand guidelines fast-vault.
key_elements: Client Header with MRR, Retainer Tier & Client Switcher Quick Link
Tab Navigation Bar (Overview, Campaigns, Social, Tasks, SEO, Ads, AI Insights, etc.)
Live Multi-Channel ROAS & Conversion Funnel Chart
Recent Client Activity & Approval Feed

hero_screen_concepts.title: Omnichannel Social Content Calendar
hero_screen_concepts.description: Drag-and-drop calendar view with platform filters (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X), copy preview, media thumbnails, and status triggers.
key_elements: Month/Week/Day Grid view with status chips (Draft, In Review, Approved, Scheduled)
Platform Filter Pills with live status count
Drag & Drop scheduling slot hover indicators
Side panel post builder with AI Copy Enhancer

hero_screen_concepts.title: Agency Task & Workflow Board
hero_screen_concepts.description: High-density agile task management board categorized by Workflow Stage (Backlog, In Progress, Creative Review, Client Approval, Done).
key_elements: Custom Swimlanes by Client or Campaign
Task Cards with assignee avatars, priority badges, subtask count, and deadline status
Filter by Assignee, Tag, Priority, and Due Date

hero_screen_concepts.title: AI Growth Engine & Recommendation Matrix
hero_screen_concepts.description: Real-time AI monitoring of ad fatigue, budget re-allocation opportunities, SEO keywords gaps, and viral hooks for active campaigns.
key_elements: AI Confidence Score Indicators (e.g. 98% Confidence)
One-Click 'Execute Recommendation' Actions
Predictive Impact Metric (+24% ROAS estimated)
Historical AI Action Logs

hero_screen_concepts.title: Agency & Client Lead Pipeline
hero_screen_concepts.description: Visual deal pipeline for prospective client proposals or B2B/D2C client lead acquisition.
key_elements: Pipeline Stages (New Lead, Qualified, Demo Scheduled, Proposal Sent, Closed Won)
Lead scoring badges & activity timeline
Quick call/email logger

hero_screen_concepts.title: Client Deliverable Approval Queue
hero_screen_concepts.description: Dedicated portal where agency managers and clients review creative assets, video edits, ad copies, and monthly budgets with version history.
key_elements: Side-by-side asset comparison modal
Timestamped comments & markup feedback
One-tap 'Approve & Schedule' or 'Request Revisions' actions

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific property transitions (e.g. transition-colors duration-150, transform duration-200 ease-out). Never use universal transition: all.
micro_interactions: Smooth glow shift on AI Recommendation cards
Staggered entrance animations for dashboard grid cards (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0)
Tab line slider with layoutId on active tab navigation

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, dropdown items, quick action icons, modal triggers, pagination controls, table headers) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='client-switcher-button', data-testid='tab-campaigns-trigger', data-testid='approve-deliverable-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standards: All text tokens meet APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum on #0A0C10 canvas and #121620 card surfaces.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_1: Create depth through layered gray elevations (#0A0C10 base, #0E1117 sidebar, #121620 card, #171C28 hover/active surface) with crisp 1px borders (#1E2432).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_2: Do NOT use default HTML select or date pickers. Build custom or Shadcn dropdown/calendar components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_3: Do NOT use full-page purple/violet gradients. Maintain strict adherence to Electric Amber (#FF9F1C) for urgency/CTAs and Cyan Pulse (#00E5FF) for AI features.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_4: Ensure every clickable element has a explicit hover state that modifies background/border/text color together.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rule_5: Always include `data-testid` on all buttons, tabs, inputs, links, cards, and modal controls for end-to-end testing stability.
